description: Source code for the SqlCommandStore class managing command data in a Mattermost server, including CRUD operations and analytics.

classes.name: SqlCommandStore
classes.description: A class that manages command data in SQL database, providing methods for CRUD operations and analytics.

methods.name: newSqlCommandStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlCommandStore with command columns and query builder.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts a new command into the database after validation.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a command by its ID.

methods.name: GetByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all commands associated with a specific team.

methods.name: GetByTrigger
methods.description: Retrieves a command by team ID and trigger.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a command as deleted by setting DeleteAt timestamp.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByTeam
methods.description: Permanently deletes all commands associated with a team.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all commands created by a user.

methods.name: AnalyticsCommandCount
methods.description: Counts the number of commands, optionally filtered by team.
